evidence.r1: the FRAME sidebar and bottom filmstrip use flat dark solid panels; only the mode-switch, tool strip and Reject/Pick bars are glass
evidence.r2: the mode-switch, tool strip and bottom bars never overlap each other in shot-fv
evidence.r3: mode switch, tool strip and Reject/Pick are the only glass groups, each clearly functional
evidence.r4: mode switch, tool strip and Reject/Pick all read as the same dark frosted material
evidence.r5: no clear-variant glass appears on the page
evidence.r6: no floating control carries a saturated tint; Pick and Reject stay neutral light/dark
evidence.r7: the Exposure popover in shot-menu is a flat opaque dark box with no visible blur of the photo behind it, unlike the tool strip beside it
evidence.r8: mode switch, tool strip and Reject/Pick are capsules; filmstrip thumbnails use one small fixed radius
evidence.r9: the circular tool icons nest evenly inside the tool-strip capsule with no pinched corners
evidence.r10: Reject and Pick are capsules; the dense FRAME data table isn't rendered as a capsule
evidence.r11: the Reject numbers 1-5 share one capsule; Pick sits in its own separate capsule
evidence.r12: the icon-only tool strip never mixes with a text button in one background
evidence.r13: material is applied to the capsule shapes themselves, not to inner icons or numbers
evidence.r14: the mode switch and tool strip keep a clear gap in shot-fv, reading as deliberately separate
evidence.r15: the filmstrip's thumbnails are simply cropped at its left/right edges with no fade indicating more frames off-screen
evidence.r16: the floating bars sit over the textured hand/tool/anvil photo, which keeps visible grain and reflection, not a flat fill
evidence.r17: only the photograph, not text or data, sits behind the floating tool bars at rest
evidence.r18: mode-switch, tool strip and Reject/Pick labels read as light text with strong contrast on the dark glass
evidence.r19: shot-reduced keeps the same bars and legible controls as shot-fv
evidence.r20: the FRAME sidebar and filmstrip are fixed docked panels, so the photo stage stops well short of the right and bottom window edges
evidence.r21: a visible hard seam separates the near-black photo stage from the lighter FRAME sidebar, with no gradient blending them
evidence.r22: no extra border or darkening layer beyond the popover's own fill is visible in shot-menu
evidence.r23: captures are static; only the Exposure popover's position beside the highlighted contrast icon is visible, not any transition or press feedback
evidence.r24: tool-strip and bar content stay white/grey monochrome; the forge's orange glow is the only saturated colour, and it is in the photo
evidence.r25: light control labels sit on dark glass, not directly over colour-matched photo detail
